title: Medigap and QMB Shares of Coinsurance on a Booked Block, Resident Funds Returns
content:
In the return of a coinsurance overcharge to a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, each owed day that takes the block's supplemental share is counted at **the share the block's supplemental coverage sets**. That share follows the coverage recorded on the resident's episode under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage:

| Coverage recorded on the episode | Share of each such owed day the resident owes |
|---|---|
| Medigap Plan K, with no QMB status | the Plan K resident share, 50 percent |
| Medigap Plan L, with no QMB status | the Plan L resident share, 25 percent |
| a full-coinsurance Medigap plan (C, D, F, G, M or N), or QMB status | nothing, 0 percent |
| otherwise | the whole coinsurance, 100 percent |

## Hypothetical illustration

Six owed days, all taking the share, at $217.00 a day:

| Coverage | Coinsurance owed |
|---|---|
| Plan K, no QMB | $651.00 |
| Plan L, no QMB | $325.50 |
| Plan N | $0.00 |
| Plan L with QMB status | $0.00 |
| no Medigap plan, no QMB | $1302.00 |
